# stripe_mandate (Data Source)

A customer's authorization to charge a payment method. Look one up by its `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_setup_intent" "sepa" {
  id = "seti_123"
}

data "stripe_mandate" "sepa" {
  id = data.stripe_setup_intent.sepa.mandate
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `customer_acceptance` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer_acceptance))
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `multi_use` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--multi_use))
- `on_behalf_of` (String) The account (if any) that the mandate is intended for.
- `payment_method` (String) ID of the payment method associated with this mandate.
- `payment_method_details` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_details))
- `single_use` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--single_use))
- `status` (String) The mandate status indicates whether or not you can use it to initiate a payment. Possible values: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`.
- `type` (String) The type of the mandate. Possible values: `multi_use`, `single_use`.

<a id="nestedatt--customer_acceptance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `customer_acceptance`

Read-Only:

- `accepted_at` (Number) The time that the customer accepts the mandate.
- `online` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer_acceptance--online))
- `type` (String) The mandate includes the type of customer acceptance information, such as: `online` or `offline`. Possible values: `offline`, `online`.

<a id="nestedatt--customer_acceptance--online"></a>
### Nested Schema for `customer_acceptance.online`

Read-Only:

- `ip_address` (String) The customer accepts the mandate from this IP address.
- `user_agent` (String) The customer accepts the mandate using the user agent of the browser.



<a id="nestedatt--multi_use"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multi_use`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The amount of the payment on a multi use mandate.
- `currency` (String) The currency of the payment on a multi use mandate.

<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--acss_debit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.acss_debit`

Read-Only:

- `default_for` (List of String) List of Stripe products where this mandate can be selected automatically.
- `interval_description` (String) Description of the interval. Only required if the 'payment_schedule' parameter is 'interval' or 'combined'.
- `payment_schedule` (String) Payment schedule for the mandate. Possible values: `combined`, `interval`, `sporadic`.
- `transaction_type` (String) Transaction type of the mandate. Possible values: `business`, `personal`.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--au_becs_debit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.au_becs_debit`

Read-Only:

- `url` (String) The URL of the mandate. This URL generally contains sensitive information about the customer and should be shared with them exclusively.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--bacs_debit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.bacs_debit`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) The display name for the account on this mandate.
- `network_status` (String) The status of the mandate on the Bacs network. Can be one of `pending`, `revoked`, `refused`, or `accepted`. Possible values: `accepted`, `pending`, `refused`, `revoked`.
- `reference` (String) The unique reference identifying the mandate on the Bacs network.
- `revocation_reason` (String) When the mandate is revoked on the Bacs network this field displays the reason for the revocation. Possible values: `account_closed`, `bank_account_restricted`, `bank_ownership_changed`, `could_not_process`, `debit_not_authorized`.
- `service_user_number` (String) The service user number for the account on this mandate.
- `url` (String) The URL that will contain the mandate that the customer has signed.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--blik"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.blik`

Read-Only:

- `expires_at` (Number) Date at which the mandate expires.
- `type` (String) Type of the mandate. Possible values: `off_session`.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--card"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.card`

Read-Only:

- `india` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_details--card--india))

<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--card--india"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.card.india`

Read-Only:

- `inactive_reason` (String) The reason why the mandate has an `inactive` status. This field is only populated if the mandate is inactive. Possible values: `canceled`, `card_not_supported`, `currency_not_supported`, `expired`, `issuer_not_supported`, `processing_error`, `undetermined`.



<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--paypal"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.paypal`

Read-Only:

- `billing_agreement_id` (String) The PayPal Billing Agreement ID (BAID). This is an ID generated by PayPal which represents the mandate between the merchant and the customer.
- `payer_id` (String) PayPal account PayerID. This identifier uniquely identifies the PayPal customer.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--payto"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.payto`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount that will be collected. It is required when `amount_type` is `fixed`.
- `amount_type` (String) The type of amount that will be collected. The amount charged must be exact or up to the value of `amount` param for `fixed` or `maximum` type respectively. Defaults to `maximum`. Possible values: `fixed`, `maximum`.
- `end_date` (String) Date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, after which payments will not be collected. Defaults to no end date.
- `payment_schedule` (String) The periodicity at which payments will be collected. Defaults to `adhoc`. Possible values: `adhoc`, `annual`, `daily`, `fortnightly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semi_annual`, `weekly`.
- `payments_per_period` (Number) The number of payments that will be made during a payment period. Defaults to 1 except for when `payment_schedule` is `adhoc`. In that case, it defaults to no limit.
- `purpose` (String) The purpose for which payments are made. Has a default value based on your merchant category code. Possible values: `dependant_support`, `government`, `loan`, `mortgage`, `other`, `pension`, `personal`, `retail`, `salary`, `tax`, `utility`.
- `start_date` (String) Date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, from which payments will be collected. Defaults to confirmation time.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--pix"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.pix`

Read-Only:

- `amount_includes_iof` (String) Determines if the amount includes the IOF tax. Possible values: `always`, `never`.
- `amount_type` (String) Type of amount. Possible values: `fixed`, `maximum`.
- `end_date` (String) Date when the mandate expires and no further payments will be charged, in `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `payment_schedule` (String) Schedule at which the future payments will be charged. Possible values: `halfyearly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `weekly`, `yearly`.
- `reference` (String) Subscription name displayed to buyers in their bank app.
- `start_date` (String) Start date of the mandate, in `YYYY-MM-DD`.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--sepa_debit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.sepa_debit`

Read-Only:

- `reference` (String) The unique reference of the mandate.
- `url` (String) The URL of the mandate. This URL generally contains sensitive information about the customer and should be shared with them exclusively.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--upi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.upi`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount to be charged for future payments.
- `amount_type` (String) One of `fixed` or `maximum`. If `fixed`, the `amount` param refers to the exact amount to be charged in future payments. If `maximum`, the amount charged can be up to the value passed for the `amount` param. Possible values: `fixed`, `maximum`.
- `description` (String) A description of the mandate or subscription that is meant to be displayed to the customer.
- `end_date` (Number) End date of the mandate or subscription.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_details--us_bank_account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_details.us_bank_account`

Read-Only:

- `collection_method` (String) Mandate collection method Possible values: `paper`.



<a id="nestedatt--single_use"></a>
### Nested Schema for `single_use`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The amount of the payment on a single use mandate.
- `currency` (String) The currency of the payment on a single use mandate.
